title: Who can talk to the API server?
scenario: "Security wants every cluster login tied to a named Entra identity, no local admin accounts, and the API server reachable only from approved IPs." — CISO
mission: Prove the cluster access model and practise the "kubectl stopped working" diagnosis.
objectives: Verify local accounts disabled and Azure RBAC
Use kubelogin with your Entra identity
Tell network timeouts from identity errors

steps.title: Get credentials
steps.command: az aks get-credentials -g rg-mfs-portal-lab -n aks-mfs-portal-lab; kubelogin convert-kubeconfig -l azurecli

steps.title: Prove identity
steps.detail: kubectl get nodes, then kubectl auth whoami.

steps.title: Inspect the profile
steps.command: az aks show -g rg-mfs-portal-lab -n aks-mfs-portal-lab --query "{local:disableLocalAccounts, rbac:aadProfile.enableAzureRbac, ips:apiServerAccessProfile.authorizedIpRanges}"

steps.title: Explain the failure modes
steps.detail: Timeout vs Unauthorized vs Forbidden: which layer fails in each?

criteria.text: Entra integration with Azure RBAC is enabled
Authorized IP ranges equal your operator IP ranges
kubectl works with your Entra identity

expectedResult: Every action in the cluster is attributable to a named identity.
recovery: Timeout on kubectl after your IP changed: update operatorIpRanges, re-run bootstrap and apply 10, 30 and 40.
dont: Do not use az aks get-credentials --admin
Do not open the API server to 0.0.0.0/0
hints: kubelogin turns Azure CLI tokens into Kubernetes credentials.
Compare authorizedIpRanges with your current public IP.

interview.question: kubectl times out this morning but worked yesterday. What do you check first and why?

debrief: Timeout = network (authorized IPs, private DNS of a private cluster); 401 = authentication (token); 403 = authorization (RBAC role). Disabling local accounts removes shared kubeconfig credentials that bypass Entra.

checker.plan: Read-only: az aks show; kubectl auth whoami / get nodes.

validation.notes: Checker not implemented yet; needs a running cluster.
